text:
alex: Quick follow-up from the kv-throttle postmortem — we agreed to turn the remediation into concrete tests and clear owners. I sketched a small playbook: regression that reproduces eviction under sustained write pressure, nightly load job focusing on tail latency, and a chaos drill that forces KV eviction paths. Need owners + rough ETA.

marta: I can own the regression suite (eviction + prefix cache warmup). Planning to add tests into evals/regressions. ETA 10 business days. Will reuse `eviction_fixture` I started.

lin: I'll take the chaos drill. Need infra sandbox + a runbook for safe blast radius. Plan: two-stage drill (simulated mem pressure -> evict -> observe latency). Targeting next Thursday for a dry-run. cc @carmen for infra creds.

carmen: I can provision the sandbox and a small dedicated dataset. Will spin up a k8s namespace and add a mock load generator. ETA: 2 days for creds + 3 days for dataset prep.

sre-bot: Reminder: create ticket and link to postmortem.

alex: Added a ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4512 — contains the postmortem link and initial checklist.

marta: Implementation notes: I'll add a new pytest marker `@pytest.mark.kv_eviction` and a headless load script. Example command:
```
PYTEST_ADDOPTS= -k "kv_eviction" pytest tests/eviction_test.py::test_eviction_under_write_storm --durations=0
```
Also planning a short promptset to validate correctness under eviction (small synthetic keys + TTLs).

lin: For chaos drill I'll include controlled GPU/memory throttling and KV node cordon. Proposed playbook snippet:
```
- step: start load generator (75% write heavy)
- step: simulate mem pressure on one node (cgroups)
- step: observe eviction events and p50/p95/p99
- rollback: remove pressure, scale down generator
```
We should log metrics to the runbook dashboard.

carmen: One ask — do we want these to run pre-deploy as a gate or only nightly? Pattern from the incident: repeats around spikes + deploys. I vote for both: nightly regression + quick smoke pre-deploy (short, warm-cache check).

alex: Agreed. Action plan:
- ACTION: marta | add regression and promptset to evals repo | due 2026-04-10
- ACTION: lin | author chaos drill + dry-run | due 2026-04-07
- ACTION: carmen | provision sandbox + dataset | due 2026-04-05
- ACTION: alex | add pre-deploy smoke runner and wire up ticket automation | due 2026-04-09

marta: I'll open a PR with the test skeleton and mark it WIP. Will include instructions to run locally and CI snippet for nightly.

lin: For the chaos drill, will create a separate small incident channel for the dry-run. Anyone want to co-own escalation steps? @alex maybe for oncall coordination.

alex: I'll co-own escalation and post-drill triage. Also let's add an eval metric: regression should assert no >10% increase in 95th latency under the test profile.

sre-bot: Scheduled nightly regression job created: `eviction-regressions-nightly` (runs 02:00 UTC).

deploy-bot: Pre-deploy smoke check added to the canary pipeline (fast-kv-smoke, ~3m)

carmen: Noted. I'll reply in the ticket with the sandbox namespace and credentials once ready.

alex: Thanks all — pulling these into the postmortem follow-up board. We'll reconvene after the dry-run to decide whether to gate deploys. :thumbsup:

marta: quick note — we'll add a small promptset that includes a few long-prefix sequences to ensure KV warmup behaviour isn't causing evictions earlier than expected.

lin: logging checklist for drill: eviction events, cache-hit ratio, per-token latency, OOM/kube events.

alex: closing loop: first dry-run scheduled 2026-04-07, full rollout of tests into nightly 2026-04-10. If anything slips, update INF-4512.

carmen: thanks — will ping here when sandbox is up.

alex: nice work, team.
